name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 9 – Am 111
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 9a. Underlines the urgent need to prevent and combat hate speech by its Members, including anti-migrant and anti-Muslim rhetoric that stigmatises and discriminates against people with a migrant background or of Muslim faith; stresses that its Members have a responsibility to uphold the standards of conduct, dignity and mutual respect laid down in its Rules of Procedure and Code of Conduct; calls on its President to ensure the consistent, impartial and effective application of the relevant rules, including the effective investigation and sanctioning of conduct that breaches those standards;
